scope: One live C270 room scene, captured on the physical Jetson and passed through the frozen EfficientAD CPU export; no part ID, ForgeGrade decision, SQLite inspection or Llama advice
device: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 8GB, aarch64, Ubuntu 20.04.6, L4T 35.6.1
runtime: Separate vision_cpu_v1 Python 3.12/Torch 2.14.0+cpu for model; existing system Python 3.8/OpenCV 4.5.4/Pillow for camera and preprocessing

camera.scene_review: Live room view, not a fixed inspection rig or a physical nut; visual review was local only

model_result.timing_scope: camera open/read, PNG save, preprocessing process, model process startup/load/forward, map and overlay; excludes diagnostic launcher startup and final report write
model_result.score_interpretation: Room scene is outside the metal_nut dataset; this is not a defect finding, quality grade, accuracy result or throughput estimate

initial_issue: The first captured frame was nearly black. A separate 12-frame probe showed the image stayed dark before exposure settled; the retry used a bounded gross-darkness guard and selected frame 13.
next_step: When a nut and fixed lit inspection surface are available, capture a distinct declared part and verify real inspection record, deterministic review/alert and end-to-end timing before closing Stage 8
